slides.title: 5 QUESTIONS TO ASK BEFORE YOU SIGN FOR AN ALARM
Are you licensed?
slides.body: Ask for a licensed New York State low-voltage contractor, not a kit dropped at your door. We are one.

slides.title: Who answers the alarm?
slides.body: A siren alone wakes the block. Ask if a central station is watching and who they call.

slides.title: What if Wi-Fi or power drops?
slides.body: Ask for a cellular communicator and a backup battery, so a cut line doesn't silence it.

slides.label: Real job: sensor under a wall camera

slides.title: Is the monthly fee in writing?
slides.body: Get the install price and the monitoring fee on paper before work starts. We give a written quote.

slides.title: Who do I call in year two?
slides.body: Ask who services the panel, swaps batteries and fixes false alarms after the installer leaves.
